usage.desc: Mounting/unmounting a node with a native-thread animation instead of a hard cut. Modal, BottomSheet and Toast already use it internally.
One or an array — `['fade', 'slide-up']` combines opacity and a slide. `pop` is a spring by default.
One index per item staggers a list — no need for a separate library.
Hands progress (0→1) to an outside driver, e.g. a PanResponder, instead of a timing/spring.

appear.description: Also animates the first render. On false it starts already present.

delay.description: ms before starting. One delay per index staggers a list.

keepMounted.description: Keeps the node mounted on exit, only hides it.

preset.description: One or several: `['fade', 'scale']` combines opacity and scale.

value.description:
Progress 0→1 driven from outside. With this, Transition only interpolates:
whoever passes it decides when and how it advances (a PanResponder, for example).

visible.description: Mounts on true, exits (and unmounts) on false.
